selection_method: Independent form-first qualitative ordering across complete racefields; model percentages included only for traceability and are not calibrated chances. No bookmaker odds used to order. No quotas. Review top ten as candidates; lower tiers not multi-safe. Ranks 11–15 were independently cross-checked against rival form and contemporary racecards; they are CONDITIONAL_REVIEW, not promoted A/B priorities. No automatic fill in a scratching.
scope: 29 races; 408 original runner dossiers; 372 conditionally included, 36 excluded after dated official scratches and unverified emergency projections. Final declarations, rail, track, gear and race-day pattern require further check.
priority_notes: Do not treat scenario-sensitive candidates as automatic multi legs. Ascot R6 is withheld despite Afireofgidgeecoals and Aurum Belle both plausible, because Good 4 / Soft 5 changes the modelled leader. Lower five are conditional, not automatic multi legs. Do not conflate model rank with researched rank.
